title: Pure Gusto
summary: Gusto cards with Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon and generic staples. Gusto is a WIND Psychic and Winged Beast Synchro deck whose monsters float into the next body from the Deck and recycle from the GY.

summary.title: Starters
points: Gusto Vedir sends a Gusto from the Deck to the GY to Special Summon another Gusto from the hand, and Special Summons itself from the hand or GY whenever a face-up Gusto is destroyed by battle or sent to the GY.
Pilica, Descendant of Gusto revives a WIND Tuner from the GY in Defense Position when Normal or Special Summoned, setting up an immediate Level 6 Synchro Summon.
Gusto Griffin Special Summons any Gusto monster from the Deck whenever it is sent from the hand to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Pilica or Vedir + Gusto Tuner
steps: Use Gusto Vedir to dump Gusto Gulldo (Level 3 Tuner) and Special Summon Pilica, Descendant of Gusto from the hand, or Normal Summon Pilica with a WIND Tuner already in the GY.
Pilica revives Gusto Gulldo from the GY, then tune Level 3 Pilica and Level 3 Gulldo for Daigusto Laplampilica.

Daigusto Laplampilica Special Summons one Gusto from the hand and one from the Deck, then immediately Synchro Summons a second Gusto Synchro such as Daigusto Sphreez or Daigusto Eguls using only those two monsters.

summary.title: Recruit & Float Loop
summary.text: Gusto Tuners replace themselves to keep bodies on the field: Gusto Gulldo summons a Level 2 or lower Gusto when sent from the field to the GY, Gusto Falco summons a Gusto face-down when sent to the GY except by battle, Gusto Egul and Winda, Priestess of Gusto recruit from the Deck when destroyed by battle, and Gusto Squirro summons a Level 5 or higher Gusto when destroyed by card effect. Caam, Serenity of Gusto shuffles two Gustos from the GY into the Deck to draw a card.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Daigusto Sphreez adds a Gusto from the GY to the hand on Synchro Summon, cannot be destroyed by battle, and reflects all battle damage your Gusto monsters would take onto your opponent.

Musto, Oracle of Gusto shuffles a Gusto from the GY into the Deck to negate a face-up monster's effects, while Reeze, Whirlwind of Gusto permanently swaps control of one of your Gustos with an opponent's monster.

Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon (made with a Level 5 or 6 Daigusto Synchro and a Level 3 or 2 Gusto Tuner) negates monster effects, while Daigusto Gulldos pops face-up monsters and Daigusto Phoenix grants a WIND monster two attacks.
Pilica, Descendant of Gusto and Daigusto Laplampilica lock you into Special Summoning only WIND monsters for the rest of the turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Tailwind of Gusto equips to a Gusto to prevent its destruction once per turn, Special Summons a Gusto from the Deck or Tuner depending on the equipped monster's Level or Rank, and banishes itself from the GY to discard a WIND monster (triggering Gusto Griffin) and search a Gusto Spell or Trap.
Contact with Gusto shuffles two Gustos from the GY into the Deck to destroy an opponent's card, and Blessings for Gusto shuffles two back to revive a third.
